name: Mail room
belongs: Every chat that does not clearly fit another room: client proposals and pricing, ad campaigns and marketing plans, email and messaging outreach, business reports and meeting minutes, invoices and taxes, info-products and business ideas, personal planning and reflection, notes and knowledge-base upkeep, computer housekeeping, research and general questions.
examples: Draft a proposal a client can skim and approve, with two payment options
Plan this month's ad campaigns for a weekly budget and tell me what to measure
How much surcharge and interest do I owe on a late tax payment?
Turn these voice notes from the meeting into minutes with owners and deadlines
